title.zh: 实验室报告制作协调员

vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Assemble environmental testing laboratory reports under document-control procedures and verify identifiers, units and attachments.
requirements.zh: 按文件控制程序编制环境检测实验室报告，并核验编号、单位及附件。

requirements.en: Maintain draft and final-document status with clear traceability.
requirements.zh: 维护草稿及最终文件状态，确保清晰可追溯性。

requirements.en: Communicate workflow status and refer technical interpretation to authorized reviewers.
requirements.zh: 沟通流程状态，并将技术解释转交获授权审核人员。

requirements.en: Preferred: independently interpret analytical results and sign laboratory reports.
requirements.zh: 优先：独立解释分析结果并签署实验室报告。
